name: lnav
description: Advanced log file navigator with automatic format detection, SQL queries, timeline view, and multi-file correlation

lnav.description: Advanced ncurses-based log file navigator with automatic format detection, SQL querying, timeline visualization, and intelligent multi-file correlation
lnav.usage:
lnav /var/log/apache2/*.log
lnav -c ';UPDATE access_log SET status = 500 WHERE status = 404' access.log
lnav -n -c '.schema' error.log
lnav -c 'SELECT * FROM syslog_log WHERE log_level = "ERROR"' /var/log/syslog
